question: The Sl unit of 'ultimate stress' is _______ .
solution:
The correct answer is __pascal (Pa).__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The ultimate stress__ of a material is the maximum stress that a material can withstand before failure.
 
• It is measured as force per unit area.
 
• The SI unit of stress, including ultimate stress, is the __pascal (Pa)__, which is equivalent to N/m².
 
• 1 Pascal is defined as one newton per square meter (N/m²).
 
• Ultimate stress is a critical parameter in determining the structural integrity of materials in engineering applications.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Stress:**

 
 
• Stress is a measure of internal resistance offered by a material to external forces.
 
• It is commonly categorized into tensile stress, compressive stress, and shear stress.
 
 
 
• **Strain:**
 
 
• Strain is the measure of deformation or change in shape due to applied stress.
 
• It is a dimensionless quantity, represented as the ratio of change in dimension to the original dimension.
 
 
 
• **Elastic Limit:**
 
 
• The elastic limit is the maximum stress a material can endure without permanent deformation.
 
• Beyond this limit, the material undergoes plastic deformation.
